title: HELIX GLTransaction Resource
description: A general ledger journal transaction — the atomic unit of financial accounting. Carries account, fund, department, program, amount, and ledger coding. Maps from PeopleSoft chartfields and Workday worktags.

helix_id.description: HELIX-assigned unique identifier for this GLTransaction record.

business_unit.description: Workday Company = organizational entity. Map to HELIX Institution or business unit.

fiscal_year.description: Workday uses fiscal period calendars. Derive year from the fiscal period containing the accounting date.

accounting_period.description: Workday fiscal periods are configurable. Standard: 12 monthly + adjustment periods.

account.description: Map Workday ledger account to HELIX account code via XREF. E.g., WD '6200 - Travel' → HELIX 'EXP-TRAVEL-DOM'.

fund_code.description: Map Workday Fund worktag to HELIX fund category. E.g., WD 'FD100 - General Operating' → HELIX 'unrestricted_general'.

department.description: Map Workday Cost Center to HELIX org code. E.g., WD 'CC-CS - Computer Science' → HELIX 'CS'.

program_code.description: Map Workday Revenue/Spend Category to HELIX functional classification. E.g., WD 'Instruction' → HELIX 'instruction'.

project_id.description: Map Workday Grant/Project worktag to HELIX project ID.

amount.description: Debit amounts positive, credit amounts negative. Or use Ledger_Debit_Amount / Ledger_Credit_Amount for ledger currency.

currency.description: ISO 4217 code. Workday natively uses ISO currency codes.

journal_source.description: Source of the journal: 'Manual', 'Accounts Payable', 'Accounts Receivable', 'Payroll', 'Asset Accounting', etc.

meta.description: HELIX metadata block — present on every resource.
